Autocomplete

source.javascript: export function createAutocomplete(root){const open=root.querySelector('[data-open]');const surface=root.querySelector('[data-surface]');if(open instanceof HTMLButtonElement&&surface instanceof HTMLDialogElement){const show=()=>surface.showModal();open.addEventListener('click',show);return{destroy(){open.removeEventListener('click',show);}}}return{destroy(){}}}document.querySelectorAll('[data-component="autocomplete"]').forEach(createAutocomplete);

title: Meter Group
summary: A dependency-free meter group pattern inspired by PrimeNG.
overview: An original native implementation of the meter group contract using platform primitives.

component.useWhen: Use meter group when its semantic contract fits the task.
component.avoidWhen: Avoid meter group when a simpler native element communicates the task more clearly.

examples.title: Basic Meter Group
examples.description: A complete independently runnable meter group preview.

source.html: 45%
source.javascript: export function createMeterGroup(root){const open=root.querySelector('[data-open]');const surface=root.querySelector('[data-surface]');if(open instanceof HTMLButtonElement&&surface instanceof HTMLDialogElement){const show=()=>surface.showModal();open.addEventListener('click',show);return{destroy(){open.removeEventListener('click',show);}}}return{destroy(){}}}document.querySelectorAll('[data-component="meter-group"]').forEach(createMeterGroup);
